title: PreResolutionProtocol
description: A deterministic protocol that attempts to reduce expert disagreement. Pre-resolution can organize disagreement; it cannot authorize execution.

protocol_id.description: Unique identifier for this protocol instance.

input_conflict_id.description: Conflict ID this protocol operates on.

deterministic.description: Must be true. Non-deterministic protocols are rejected.

requires_human_approval.description: Whether this protocol requires human approval to run.

bounded_reference_required.description: Whether a bounded reference index is required for this protocol.

allowed_scope.description: Paths this protocol is allowed to reference.
